title: Add untrusted content runtime workflow
purpose: Create the Alpha workflow contract for fetching, sanitizing, summarizing, and auditing untrusted external content.
scope: Define net/content semantic workflow steps for untrusted webpages or documents.
Apply source-to-sink policy before any high-risk action.
Ensure content summary cannot become direct tool execution.
Record denied actions and risk flags in audit projection.
deliverables: Untrusted content workflow design or initial implementation
acceptance_criteria: External content is labeled untrusted by default.
Untrusted/model-origin content cannot directly drive shell, login, secret, privileged, or network exfiltration sinks.
Sanitized summary can produce replanning hints but not direct effects.
Denied actions are visible in runtime audit projection.
verification: Run source-to-sink or prompt-injection safety tests.
Run a fixture where webpage text asks to execute shell and confirm denial.
Confirm audit projection records the denial without preparing effects.
risk_notes: Untrusted content is the main prompt-injection path for AgentOS workflows.
implementation_steps: Route source labels into source-to-sink policy.
Add smoke or safety fixture evidence.
failure_modes: External content is treated as operator-trusted.
Sanitized summary can create direct tool calls.
Denied high-risk sink still prepares an effect.
Audit projection hides the source label.

verification_matrix.expected: Untrusted content cannot trigger high-risk sinks

blocked_until: Audit projection shows denied action context.
